samples.title: Phân loại rác
samples.prompt: The proposal is that neighbourhoods should make household waste sorting easier. Do the advantages of this proposal outweigh its disadvantages?
requirementsVi: Chọn bên có sức nặng hơn.
Thừa nhận và phân tích bất lợi.
So sánh mức độ tác động, không chỉ đếm số ý.
samples.summaryVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that neighbourhoods should make household waste sorting easier has both positive and negative aspects. In my view, the advantages can outweigh the disadvantages if basic practical support is included. The main benefit addresses a recurring everyday need, while at least some of the difficulties can be reduced through careful organisation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu đánh giá và điều kiện rõ ràng.

parts.text: The proposal that
parts.labelVi: Giới thiệu đề xuất + mệnh đề

parts.text: neighbourhoods should make household waste sorting easier has both positive and negative aspects.
In my view,
parts.labelVi: Nêu quan điểm cá nhân

parts.text: the advantages can outweigh the disadvantages if basic practical support is included. The main benefit addresses a recurring everyday need, while at least some of the difficulties can be reduced through careful organisation.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận bất lợi
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. This matters because extra effort feels pointless when separated bags are later mixed together. For instance, a careful resident may see all bins emptied into one truck and decide not to separate waste again. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không bỏ qua phía yếu hơn.

parts.text: a careful resident may see all bins emptied into one truck and decide not to separate waste again. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích lớn hơn
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that more recyclable material can be collected separately. This is possible because clear containers reduce the chance that paper and plastic become mixed with food waste. For example, a family can keep a small box for clean bottles instead of putting them in the same bag as dinner leftovers. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

paragraphs.label: So sánh sức nặng
paragraphs.text: I give greater weight to the benefit because it could help people repeatedly, not just on one special occasion. The disadvantage is still important, but it is not always unavoidable. One response would be to give residents an easy way to report leaks and explain who should respond. A building manager could keep a repair log and confirm when each report has been checked. This gives a concrete reason to believe that the obstacle can be reduced rather than merely ignored.

paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I believe the advantages are greater when the approach is organised responsibly. If the practical support is absent, the balance could change. The strongest case is therefore for a workable version of the proposal, not for assuming that any version will automatically succeed.
